skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Invitation
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Invitation. A set of formalwear Harmonie wears while enjoying the afternoon in her study. The smart tailoring makes her skirt move in a beautiful curve, and the fabrics are specially chosen to hide any stray fur stuck on her clothes.
skins.quote: Harmonie rarely allows anyone into her study, a private space for her alone. The room is furnished with elegant furniture, but she is happy to sit on the table with her tail slightly raised, her staff teasing the sunlight.

skins.name: Decoration
skins.content: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Decoration. A cute dress Harmonie rarely wears. With its adjustable fit and flexible materials, it can accentuate the body's natural curves better than any other. The accessories are all from her beloved private collection.
skins.quote: On special occasions, Harmonie will redecorate her room, paying meticulous attention to every detail, all for the sake of appeasing her long-lost maiden's heart.
